title: docs(skills): the ask skill and ADR-0149 D3 ask back only about a word with a measure candidate
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DK3yGUPi8j7HBaXCzoa37AN)_

Fixes #35158

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用 AI 助手问数的业务用户,问「按行业看销售额」这类话(「销售额」对上了指标,「按行业」只是接近一个分组维度)时,助手照着问数技能不再反问「你说的行业是哪一个」,直接算出销售额并按行业分组;只说「销售」这种只接近某个指标的词,仍然先问清楚再算。
- 为什么做:属于「MCP 问数」专题。上一轮(#35005,问数反问范围收窄)已把工具说明和连接时下发的规则改成「只对可能是指标的词反问」,但问数技能、返回结构的说明和架构决策记录还写着「凡有候选就反问」,两种说法并存,助手可能照旧多问一句。
- 出错会怎样:只改文字,不动任何计算逻辑,指标口径不变;最坏情况是助手把一个本该问清的分组词直接拿来分组,或对个别问法仍多问一句。撤回本次改动即可恢复原文。
- 要你做什么:席位核对与合同审核通过后,批准这次受管文本(问数技能与架构决策记录)的改动;在那之前无需动作。

## What changes

The sentence every copy now carries is the one the two door strings on `main` share since PR #35156 (commit `7ed18b50e1`): "A word whose candidates are all dimensions is at most a possible grouping: never ask about it, and it never stops a matched measure." A word with a measure among its candidates keeps the rule as it was: it is asked about. No shape, executor or tool changes.

- **Skill, step 2** (`skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`). The one `candidates` row is now two, placed directly under the "One word matches several measures" row:
  - "A word with a measure among its `candidates`": "Ask the same way; with one candidate, ask whether it is the one meant."
  - "A word whose `candidates` are all dimensions": "At most a possible grouping: never ask about it, and it never stops a matched measure." The door sentence, split over the row's two cells.
- **Skill, step 1 bullet** (same file). It says what a candidate is and states no ask-back, so it needed no scope. It lost three words (" on the answer") as payment.
- **Paid inside the same file.** The `objectstack-ask` row of `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` had no headroom and is not edited: 1877 / 1877 before and after. The two rows are paid for by cutting text that restated another line of the same file (ruling record 6513306068: pay by cutting restatement first). Each cut keeps its other home:
  - the old row's own listing instruction and its "Do not pick one." (the row above states both, and the new row says "Ask the same way");
  - "A word matches nothing, and" in the old row's left cell (step 1: "A word that matched nothing may have `candidates`");
  - " on the answer" in that step 1 bullet (the same bullet: "a member the same answer lists").
- **Generated page** (`packages/mcp/src/ask-skill.generated.ts`). Rewritten by `node scripts/gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs`, never by hand. It is what `GET /mcp/skill` serves.
- **Spec description** (`packages/spec/src/ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts`). `ListDatasetsOutputSchema.candidates` said every candidate is offered "for a clarifying question". It now says the clarifying question is for a term with a measure among its candidates and states, declaratively and in the file's own vocabulary, that a term whose candidates are all dimensions is offered them as a possible grouping, not for a question, and does not stop a matched measure (contract review 7024432523 F1: the executor's imperative sentence stays out of the spec, ADR-0149 M1). The doc comment of `DatasetTermCandidateSchema` says the same and names how the kind is read (the `measures.` or `dimensions.` prefix of `member`). `list_datasets` serves this description in its `outputSchema`. The Zod shape is byte-for-byte what it was.
- **Regenerated reference** (`content/docs/references/ai/dataset-tools.mdx`). One table row, by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:docs`.
- **ADR-0149 D3** (`docs/adr/0149-ai-answers-business-questions-through-the-dataset-semantic-layer.md`). Three edits, none deciding anything the door strings and the executor's note on `main` do not already say:
  - rule 1's parenthesis now points at the new note: "scoped by the amendment note of 2026-11-19 after rule 5: a word whose candidates are all dimensions is at most a possible grouping, never asked about";
  - the third point of the candidates note now opens "With a measure among a term's candidates, the AI asks in rule 3's form and acts on none." and ends with one sentence for a term whose candidates are all dimensions;
  - a new amendment note (2026-11-19) cites the maintainer's ruling [7024577075](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/35158#issuecomment-7024577075) as its authority, says it amends rule 1 in place and narrows #34691 F1 = B for dimension candidates only, quotes the door sentence with its two symbol anchors and the test that holds them equal (the spec carries the scope, not that sentence), says what holds for each kind of term, that rule 5 still holds, what does not change, and what the two amended sentences first said.
- **Eval cases** (`skills/objectstack-ask/evals/metric-selection-fallback.json`), ids 16 and 17, in the file's existing shape:
  - 16: 「按行业看销售额」, where 销售额 matches a measure and 「按行业」 has one candidate, a dimension. Expected: one `query_dataset` call grouped by industry and no question back.
  - 17: "What are our sales?", where "sales" matches nothing and its one candidate is a measure. Expected: a question and nothing else.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/35158-ask-back-measure-scope.md`: `@objectstack/skills`, `@objectstack/mcp` and `@objectstack/spec` at `patch`. `Clause-②: no`: a text-only change to served text; no tool, field or argument changes. `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Skills size readings

| Reading | Before (`2495486fd5`) | After (`ce88a4ea69`) |

| `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md` priced tokens (ceiling) | 1877 (1877) | 1877 (1877) |

The file is one line and one byte longer: 7508 priced bytes, exactly 4 × 1877, so the row keeps zero headroom and no ceiling moves. The bundle total grows by 773 tokens, all of it the eval fixture (4615 to 5388), which the ratchet measures and does not ratchet. No other file under `skills/` changes.

## Tests

All at `ce88a4ea69`, each heavy run under the shared verify lock.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test`: Test Files 79 passed (79), Tests 1439 passed (1439), `VERDICT command-exit 0`. It includes `skill-single-source-34686.test.ts` (the generated page equals the skill) and `initialize-selection-rule-34686.test.ts`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 859 passed (859), Tests 27439 passed, 1 todo, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck`: `VERDICT command-exit 0` each.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/dataset-tools.test.ts` (the suite that reads the `list_datasets` output schema): 1 file, 92 passed, 10 skipped, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- No ablation: the diff changes text, generated copies and fixtures, and no behaviour a test pins.

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise, measured on `main`.** Both door strings carry the sentence (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts#DATASET_SELECTION_RULE`, `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts#LIST_DATASETS_DESCRIPTION`), and the executor's note adds "group the answer only as the question asks" (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-next-step.ts`). The skill row, the spec description and the two ADR sentences still stated the question for every candidate.
- **Governed.** `skills/**` and `docs/adr/**` are Tier H. This PR stays a draft; its author never readies, queues or arms it.
- **Claim and file surface.** Claimed by comment 7013669358 on the card. The seven changed files are all inside the claim's list. `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is in that list and is not changed.
- **The spec description states the scope, not an instruction.** The file's header says the tool descriptions are the executor's and "AI guidance text does not enter the spec (ADR-0149 M1, ruled A)". After contract review 7024432523 (F1, option B) the description and doc comment state what the platform offers for each kind of term, in declarative form; the imperative sentence lives only in the two door strings and the skill.
- **ADR provenance.** The note is approved by the maintainer on this PR, verbatim 「不再反问」, ruling record [7024577075](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/35158#issuecomment-7024577075) on #35158: a term whose candidates are all dimensions is not asked about and may be used as the grouping the question asks for, which narrows #34691 F1 = B for dimension candidates only; a measure candidate is still asked about and never selected. Two sentences that mention the question in passing are left as written and named in the note.
- **Eval cases are not graded here.** The strict loader reads the file (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --dry-run`: "objectstack-ask: 17 case(s)", exit 0). No model round was run for ids 16 and 17: NOT MEASURED, the eval round's reading.
- **Seen and left alone** (outside this card's file surface; nothing was filed):
  - `docs/design/mcp-local-first-door.md` still describes the ask-back over `candidates` without the scope, in two sentences;
  - a code comment in `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-term-matcher.ts` says a candidate is "offered for a clarifying question";
  - the release notes and package changelogs that quote the earlier wording are release-owned.
- **Overlap.** `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD` at `ce88a4ea69`: VERDICT clean, exit 0, against `origin/main` `5dd856f40c` and 1 PR head (#35129, the Version Packages pull, which shares the skill file and merges cleanly).

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `docs/adr/0149-ai-answers-business-questions-through-the-dataset-semantic-layer.md`: the new note of 2026-11-19, its points "A term whose candidates are all dimensions is a possible grouping, not a question" and "Rule 5 still holds for it". Check that each says no more than the door sentence and the executor's note.
2. `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`: step 2's two new rows. "Ask the same way" leans on the row directly above it, so the row order matters.
3. `packages/spec/src/ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts`: the `candidates` description, for the note on M1 above.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs && node scripts/gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs --check`. Expect both to exit 0, the ask row to read `1877 /   1877   (+0)`, and the generator to say the page "is current with skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md".

## Fix round (contract review 7024432523, FAIL → head `df2fcffbf3`)

| Item | Where | Change |
|:--|:--|:--|
| F1 (must-fix) | `packages/spec/src/ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts` | The `candidates` description and the `DatasetTermCandidateSchema` doc comment state the dimension-only scope declaratively in the file's own vocabulary ("term"); the executor's imperative sentence is gone from the spec (ADR-0149 M1). `content/docs/references/ai/dataset-tools.mdx` regenerated; the changeset sentence and the ADR note say the spec carries the scope, not the door sentence. |
